name: Mention words: sell YES
description: Taker: buys NO at the proven YES bid (10-90c) within 3 h of a Trump-mention word market's first trade, one entry per market, held to settlement.
hypothesis: Opening YES prices on mention-word markets are ~14c too high (36% said vs ~50c); sell-YES at the proven bid nets +6.5c (t~1.7) on the 150-market sample. Wrong if the walk-forward CI <= 0. Sample-limited: ~130 markets, no lockbox data (history ends Aug 17).
